T1.bfs: breadth-first search: a FIFO queue expands cells in order of distance from start
T1.dfs: depth-first search: a LIFO stack or recursion follows one branch as deep as possible before backtracking (recursive and iterative versions are the same algorithm)
T1.bidirectional_bfs: bidirectional BFS: two FIFO frontiers grow from start and from goal and stop when they meet
T1.iddfs: iterative deepening DFS: repeated depth-limited DFS with an increasing depth limit
T1.astar_greedy: heuristic best-first search: a priority queue ordered by a goal-distance heuristic h (greedy best-first) or by g+h (A*)
T1.dijkstra_unit: Dijkstra / uniform-cost search: a priority queue ordered by path cost g only, no heuristic

T2.dijkstra: Dijkstra: repeatedly settle the unsettled node with the smallest tentative distance (binary heap or linear scan), relaxing its outgoing edges
T2.bellman_ford_spfa: Bellman-Ford / SPFA: relax all edges in rounds until nothing changes, or a FIFO queue of nodes whose distance changed (nodes may be processed many times)
T2.bidirectional_dijkstra: bidirectional Dijkstra: one Dijkstra search forward from s and one backward from t over reversed edges, stopping when the frontiers meet
T2.floyd_warshall: Floyd-Warshall: all-pairs dynamic programming over an n x n distance matrix with three nested loops over k, i, j
T2.dial: Dial's algorithm: Dijkstra with an array of buckets indexed by integer distance instead of a heap
